mapper.sql:
FROM sys_app a JOIN sys_menu m ON m.permission = a.access_permission AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id AND rm.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id AND ur.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE a.code = #{appCode} AND a.is_deleted = 0
AND u.update_time > #{updatedAfter}
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS workspace_user_id, u.username, u.real_name, u.email, u.mobile, u.gender, u.dept_id, u.status, u.password AS password_hash, u.update_time AS updated_at
ORDER BY u.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
